description: Revoke a previously issued memory grant immediately. Returns JSON revocation receipt. Compliance: GDPR Art. 7, 17. Cost $0.01 per call.

grant_id.description: UUID of the grant to revoke.

wallet_signature.description: EIP-191 signature of the grantor over the revoke message.

name: memory.revoke

outputSchema.description: Revocation receipt for a memory grant.

note.description: Present when the grant was already revoked.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Memory Revoke
